status_note: LD-merlin-ue (2026-09-29): UE import of the Merlin look-dev run (merlin-h2-lookdev/1: H2.1 rig + UV1, concept-toned BC, MatID, class LUT, EdgeMask) onto M_UM_Figure_v2 through the CLI profile skeletal-adopt. The figure MI is a child of /Game/UM/Materials/v2/M_UM_Figure_v2 (MatID, hero LUT 16x16, EdgeMask, UV1 in metres); the base keeps M_UM_BaseMarker (team band). At most «технически импортировано / измерено»; no art acceptance, no budget (GD-058 open); Blue/Red diagnostic pair (Q-304 open).
derived_from: art/pipeline-candidates/ASSET-MERLIN-001/build-profiles/merlin-h2-ue-import.json (W5c-A H2.1 import: armature, sockets, axes, scale, team pair, base marker)
art/pipeline-candidates/ASSET-MERLIN-001/build-profiles/merlin-h2-lookdev-ue-lut.json (UE inputs: LUT v2 layout, EdgeMask, debug zone ID; UE look-dev layer)

h21_build_report.note: bones, sockets, round-trip bounds of H2.1: the look-dev export proved rig/geometry/weights equal to it

candidate.textures_note: 2K runtime set of the look-dev run + UE inputs of lookdev_ue_inputs.py (LUT 16x16 v2 layout instead of the EXR 16x8 of the Blender stage, EdgeMask = TeamMaskRGBA.A as its own texture, LDV-1/LDV-8). ZoneID is a DEBUG input: only the debug MI MI_Merlin_H2LD_DebugZones reads it (zone masks of the look-dev measurement). The 4K masters and TeamMaskRGBA are never imported

armature.bones_note: UM_HUMANOID_17_v2: 16 body bones + weapon.R (Merlin's staff, rigid 100 %). In UE the armature object SKEL_UM_Humanoid becomes bone 0 (18 bones), '.' becomes '_' (weapon_R)

scale.note: hood top 45.0 uu above the base bottom (bake measures.hood_top_uu 44.986); the staff crystal is the skeletal top (49.42 uu), not the figure height

axes.expected_ue_front_source: 04-blender-production.md §1 «Оси» + §1.1 preset UM_FBX_v1 (ART-001); the bake measured the face +3.4 uu ahead of the body centroid along +X in the export frame

sockets.name: Weapon
sockets.purpose: rig-contract §7: Weapon on the weapon bone at (0,0,0) = the grip on the staff axis

sockets.name: Head
sockets.purpose: damage / status VFX; location = the bake's UE bone-space prediction (face part bbox centre)

sockets_note: StaffTip (crystal centre, AD-CNF-59 open) stays a proposal in the bake report and is not created in UE

expectations.note: numbers of the H2.1 bake (build-report.json of merlin-h2-bake/2); the FBX carries LOD0 only

proposed_limits_for_comparison_only.source: bake profile budget_proposal (figure 30-45 k tris, 4K master + 2K runtime, <= 2 slots) and 04 §3.4 — ПРЕДЛОЖЕНИЕ до решения GD-058, не бюджет

ue.teams_note: diagnostic pair for the W5c frames (task: TeamColor blue and red); С-11 Gold/Silver stays the palette proposal (Q-304 open). Linear only through FLinearColor::FromSRGBColor (AD-OPEN-39 rule). Proposal
ue.team_color_mode_note: user decision 2026-09-28 (AD-CNF-58 = b): TeamColor on the clothing by TeamMask.R (H2.1 mask: robe with hood 0.82, sleeves 0.87-0.89; skin, face, staff, crystal, shoes 0) and on the base side band
ue.figure_parameters_note: as H2.1 (W5c-A): TeamColor x luminance(BC) x 5.5 on the wool (the only teamDyeAllowed class of the Merlin LUT: silk embroidery, leather, skin, wood, bronze are never dyed, LDM-1/LDV-7). Other v2 knobs at the master defaults. Look-dev changes are recorded in the LD-merlin-ue decisions

base_marker.note: textured H2 base (24 x 24 x 5 uu, same atlas): team band = the side wall (|n.z| < SideBandNormalZMax), flat TeamColor; as W4-B. Proposal

N.note: DirectX normal of the bake (green of the OpenGL bake inverted); no OpenGL copy exists and none is imported

ORM.note: R AO, G roughness, B metallic, linear; TC_Masks keeps the three channels independent (no sRGB curve)

TeamMask.note: single-channel L8 mask: TC_Grayscale stores it uncompressed (G8), no channel is lost; M_UM_Figure samples it as LinearGrayscale (W4-B)

MatID.note: G8 class id x16+8, read with Load (LDM-4: 2K)

EdgeMask.note: L8 convexity (TeamMaskRGBA.A of the look-dev run), EdgeMaskTexture of M_UM_Figure_v2

MatLUT.note: hero LUT 16x16 RGBA16F (DDS), read with Load

ZoneID.note: DEBUG: look-dev zone id for MI_Merlin_H2LD_DebugZones only

ZoneLUT.note: DEBUG: flat zone colours (metal path, row 0) for MI_Merlin_H2LD_DebugZones only

ue.target_skeleton_note: волна 5c (H2Anim, CLI 0.8.0): меш H2 импортируется на канонический скелет героя (создан tools/tripo-pipeline/anim/h2anim_ue.py skeleton из SK_Merlin_H2.fbx), клипы H2Anim привязаны к нему же; своего SK_Merlin_H2_Skeleton прогон больше не создаёт, повторный импорт канонический скелет не удаляет
ue.masters_note: figure on M_UM_Figure_v2 (library v1 classes: MatID + hero LUT + detail arrays, Cloth per pixel, dye only on teamDyeAllowed classes); base stays on M_UM_BaseMarker v1 (team side band for board readability, W4-B/5b-R); M_UM_Figure_v2 keeps every v1 parameter name, so um_masters_current checks the v1 spec parameters on it
ue.figure_static_switches_note: the look-dev FBX carries UV1 in metres (LDM-8): 2 detail samples instead of the 6 of the triplanar fallback, wood grain along U on the rotated staff islands (tangent of UV1 from derivatives, LDV-4)

extra_instances.purpose: no dye: TeamColor white x TeamDye 0 = the baked concept tone (concept comparison)
debug: class colour of the MatID (emissive only)
debug: look-dev zone colours (ZoneID in the MatID slot) = zone masks of the UE-vs-concept measurement
